cases.name: Production React application mounts at mobile viewport
IndexedDB restores reading position and preference after reload
50 sequential real Pi loops complete with simulated model transport
Simulated transport failure preserves the last committed result
UI remains interactive during a pending request and cancellation preserves state
Reload during pending work preserves committed data and a new run succeeds
Loaded application reads and saves locally while browser network is disabled
No horizontal overflow at widths 360, 390, and 768
Browser reports native bridge as untested rather than simulating native success
No browser JavaScript or console errors

caveats: Chromium browser, not Android WebView or a physical phone.
Pi core and tools are real; model responses and transport failures are simulated.
No real model API, Android lifecycle, native bridge runtime, battery, device memory, or long-duration performance measured.
